observations: Single photo shows a white 4-burner gas cooker with an oven compartment underneath.
Unit is sitting outdoors on bare ground/pavement next to other secondhand appliances.
No brand name, logo, or model number is visible anywhere on the control panel, body, or oven door.
A watermark reading 'POSTED ON JIJI / TOGHI HOME APPLIANCES' appears on the image; this is a platform/seller tag, not a manufacturer mark.
Four knobs are visible on the control panel; burners appear intact with no visible rust or damage from this angle.
Back of unit, gas hose/connection point, and interior of oven are not visible in this single photo.

claims.evidence: No import markings, country-of-origin label, or distributor sticker visible in photo 0.
Photo 0 clearly shows four burners arranged on the cooktop.
Static photo cannot show ignition, flame, or oven heating; no video or lit-burner shot provided.
No warranty card, receipt, or document shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Burners may not ignite or may have uneven flame.
risks.proof: Short video clip showing each of the 4 burners being lit and burning steadily.

risks.risk: Oven may not heat or heating element may be faulty.
risks.proof: Video or photo of oven interior glowing/heating with a thermometer or visible flame.

risks.risk: Gas hose, regulator, or rear connection could be damaged, missing, or leaking.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the back of the cooker showing the gas inlet and any attached hose/regulator.

risks.risk: Hidden rust, dents, or damage on sides/back not shown in the single front-angle photo.
risks.proof: Additional photos from the back, both sides, and underneath the unit.

risks.risk: Control knobs may be loose, broken, or mismatched (common in used units).
risks.proof: Close-up photo/video of each knob being turned and clicking into ignition position.

risks.risk: Claimed 'warranty' has no verifiable issuer, duration, or coverage.
risks.proof: Photo of a physical warranty card/receipt with seller or shop name and date.

proof_requests: Video of all 4 burners being lit and burning with visible flame.
Video/photo of oven heating up with door open showing glow or heat.
Close-up photo of the back of the unit showing gas inlet, hose, and regulator condition.
Photos of both sides and the back of the cooker for rust/dent inspection.
Photo of any warranty document, if one exists.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a 4-burner gas cooker with oven, but functional claims like working condition and warranty are unverified from a single static photo, so it must be priced at worst case (as not working) until proof is given.
